description: Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets is an open data portal listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets, published or maintained by Open Energy Platform (Reiner Lemoine Institut and partners). The Open Energy Platform keeps a register of energy-system models and modelling frameworks, each with a factsheet that gives purpose, institution, licence, code link, sector and geographic coverage, software and data formats. The record lists the register as a whole; every factsheet that was not yet catalogued became a model or platform record. Coverage: not tied to one place; individual factsheets name their own. 340 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 224 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
